## Overview

This file aims to create working import script of World Bank Population Dataset,
and report the number of rows and columns

## Directions

1. Import the necessary library to read the data.

2. Load the primary data file from the correct file path.

3. Report the dataset's dimensions, including the number of rows and columns.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Set up the R session
```{r setup,  message = FALSE}
#In order to read xlsx file, I installed readxl package and load
#install.packages('readxl')
library(readxl)
#Load package
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
#check the current working directory
getwd() # R's current working directory
here() # the project root (where the .Rproj file lives)

#import dataset
population <- read_excel(here(
  "data/712population_712API_SP.POP.TOTL_DS2_en_csv_v2_5254.xlsx"), sheet = "API_SP.POP.TOTL_DS2_en_csv_v2_5")
```
#Report the dimensions
```{r report, message=FALSE}
# Finding the dimensions of the dataset
dim(population)       # rows, then columns
# 266 rows and 12 columns
#read the rows
nrow(population)       # 266 rows
#read the columns
ncol(population)       # 12 rows
#read the column names of the dataset
colnames(population)
#get a summary of the dataset, so that we can know if there is NA existed
summary(population) #there is one NA each year and it is 'Not classified'
#further get a chance to see the class of each column and first few rows
glimpse(population)
```
